title: Container Bookings: free allowance for a late VGM entry and the order of late submissions
content:
## Rule
For a late verified gross mass on a Container Bookings booking, the free allowance is counted on the booking itself, exactly as for late shipping instructions: the entry is recorded at 0.00 while the late submissions already recorded on the same booking, including a late shipping-instruction entry recorded before it, are fewer than the tier's free late-document allowance and the free allowance is open, and at the full fee otherwise. Late submissions recorded on the customer's other bookings do not count.

Late submissions are recorded in the order the documents were received, so a verified gross mass is recorded only after every late shipping-instruction entry for documents received before it is on the booking, and that earlier entry counts toward the allowance of the verified gross mass. Before the late VGM is recorded, this must hold:

> Every late shipping-instruction row for documents received before the verified gross mass is already recorded on the booking.

## Truth table (hypothetical allowance of 1)
| Late submissions already recorded on this booking | Free allowance open | Late VGM entry |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | yes | 0.00 |
| 1 (a late shipping-instruction entry recorded before it) | yes | the full fee |
| 0 | no | the full fee |

## Order case (hypothetical)
*For illustration only:* the shipping instructions arrived late on Monday and the VGM arrived late on Tuesday. The Monday instructions are recorded first; the VGM then finds one late submission already on the booking, and under an allowance of 1 it is recorded at the full fee.
